events.title: FARM BANG DEMO 2.0: QUESTS, WAYPOINTS & HUD OVERHAUL
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing during Next Fest! A lot of you told us the same thing: after the tutorial, you didn’t know what to do next. This update is our answer. events.title: Dev Log: Boss test GM0001
events.summary: Just wrapped up the first test run on GM0001, the Starter Map boss in Farm Bang.What I’m checking right now:Skill timing and animation syncHitbox accuracy vs. the telegraphReadability, so players can dodge it by reading it, not guessingStill very much WIP, so expect placeholder effects and some jank. 😅More tests coming soon. Feedback welcome!

events.title: Farm Bang Demo is OUT!
